message: 百聞は一見にしかず

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, shouldn't you be patrolling KiraFes?」

name: Synn
message: 「I am doing it properly」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, I ought to check the library too, just in case」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't school facilities off-limits during KiraFes?」

name: Synn
message: 「They are, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I figure there's probably someone holed up in here instead of showing up at KiraFes」

name: Synn
message: 「...I knew it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Patrolling」

name: Melilot
message: 「There shouldn't be any need to patrol the library」

name: Melilot
message: 「To begin with, it is off-limits today」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I just wanted to be extra thorough」

name: Melilot
message: 「How very diligent of you...」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Melilot-san? What are you doing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「My work as a librarian」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it's off-limits?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because there are students who sneak in without permission like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmm, it hurts when you put it like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, you had better head back quickly」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, about that, wouldn't you like to come along too, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I cannot leave the library unattended」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine if we lock it up. I'll help you close up the doors and windows」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems you're determined to drag me out to KiraFes no matter what」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to see what we've built too, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「I know how hard you and Sakura-kun have been working」

name: Melilot
message: 「So I can easily imagine that you're putting on an event worthy of all that effort」

name: Synn
message: 「And that's why you don't need to see it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm not particularly fond of walking through crowds, either」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... such a waste」

name: Synn
message: 「I think there are things you can only understand by experiencing them firsthand, not just through knowledge」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan is totally right!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyaa, Helena!?」

name: Helena
message: 「There are sensations you can only appreciate by touching them directly like this!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eek!? W-Wait, where do you think you're touching!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, do you want me to spell it out for you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Th-at would be, Melilot's, soft and squishy boobs\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please stop that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Aww, don't be such a meanie」

name: Helena
message: 「Want to feel them too, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-No way, I'll pass」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helenaa...」

name: Helena
message: 「Okay, okay, I get it already. It was just a little joke」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Melilot
message: 「So, why are you here, Helena?」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't it obvious? I came to invite you, Melilot」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's look around Kirafes together, okay?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You too, Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't have to make a face like that」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan is worried about you being such a homebody, Melilot. Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well... I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, we all worked so hard to put Kirafes together...」

name: Synn
message: 「I really wanted you to see it, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I don't think it's a sparkling school life if even one person isn't enjoying it」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I see」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's very like you, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Understood. I suppose I will take a brief look around」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Either way, the moment Helena caught me, I had no choice but to give up」

name: Helena
message: 「What's that supposed to mean? How rude」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're the one who's rude!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Come now, if we're going, let's hurry. I'll go check that the library is locked up」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, is something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no...」

name: Synn
message: 「Being able to bring Melilot-san out here is all thanks to you, Helena-san」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just thinking that I wouldn't have been able to invite her on my own...」

name: Helena
message: 「...That's not true at all」

name: Helena
message: 「When Melilot doesn't want to agree to something, she won't nod yes even if I'm the one inviting her」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, the most important thing is that you were the one who reached out to her, Synn-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「Not me, you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, you'll figure it out eventually」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's quite lively...」

name: Synn
message: 「The folks from the shopping district have been helping us out in all sorts of ways, too」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I'm aware」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right, of course...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I didn't expect it to get this exciting」

name: Melilot
message: 「I think it has turned into a wonderful event」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...」

name: Helena
message: 「See? Just like I said」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I was merely stating my honest impression」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu, you're so stubborn about your feelings♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't say things that invite misunderstandings」

name: Helena
message: 「What's that, are you embarrassed in front of Synn-chan?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is nothing to laugh about, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry, I couldn't help it...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, you've been going too far for a while now」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, I spooootted Tamiko-chan!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hey, please don't try to change the subject!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Why, if it isn't Helena, Melilot, and Lord Synn. Thank you for your hard work」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Riesling」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Riesling……」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you with Lolotte today?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Well, you see, the young lady has actually gone missing since a little while ago……」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am truly ashamed to admit it, but I am currently in the middle of searching for her」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh no, that's terrible!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm going to help Tamiko-chan out, so I'll leave you folks to handle things on your end!」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, let's go, Tamiko-chan!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Should you happen to find the young lady, please contact me here」
I receive an iron business card.

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「……Somehow, we ended up getting left behind, didn't we」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena is at it again, treating everything like a joke……」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is Helena we're talking about」

name: Melilot
message: 「True. Though that's putting it a bit bluntly」

name: Synn
message: 「What should we do from here?」

name: Melilot
message: 「What would you like to do, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well, only if you're okay with it, but……」

name: Synn
message: 「Would you like to walk around Kirafes a little longer?」

name: Melilot
message: 「"Only if I'm okay with it," you say」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Did I say something funny...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's just that you were rather forceful when dragging me out of the library」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, well, ahaha...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I don't mind, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're still on break from your Student Council duties, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, where might you be showing me around next?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, how about we check out the bazaar over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, wait, maybe we should stop by Prier first...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, or maybe...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee, you don't need to rush so much」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, ahaha, you're right」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you so much for today」
I was worried about how things would turn out at first, though...
I think today's KiraFes was a huge success.
More than anything, seeing Melilot-san enjoy herself might be the biggest reason why.
